description: Source code for a utility that fixes MD5 headers in WRG formatted images on MTD devices, including functions for MD5 checksum calculation, header validation, and device memory operations.

methods.name: wrg_fix_md5
methods.description: Calculates and updates the MD5 checksum in the WRG header if necessary.

methods.name: mtd_fixwrg
methods.description: Fixes the WRG header in an MTD device at a specified offset.
